description: This file defines the AccessControl struct within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions on POSIX systems. It includes functions to change ownership, set permissions, and apply access control settings based on NodeId objects.

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: A struct providing static methods to manage file ownership and permissions, including setting ownership, permissions, and applying access control based on NodeId.

methods.name: OwnerShip
methods.description: Sets the ownership of a file specified by node to the user and group provided, using POSIX functions.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Sets the permissions of a file specified by node to the modeFlags provided, using POSIX chmod.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a NodeId object, based on its rights and group properties.
